substep_parent_rule: Bind exactly one current parent action/operation. START-only pose evidence describes historical authorized origin; do not require stationary HOME during D movement. At each dependent movement recheck all invariant material/receiver/resource/history predicates and stage-specific poses. Prerequisites FEED-OPEN/ISOLATE establish start poses using own guards.
